source.symbol: Merge-automation worker and Thunderbird action configuration
source.validation: Exact public Git source at its historical revision; this does not claim the file or convention remains current. Claims are static observations. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

text:
- - "mail/confvars.sh"
                                    - "MOZ_OFFICIAL_BRANDING_DIRECTORY=comm/mail/branding/tb_beta"
                                    - "MOZ_OFFICIAL_BRANDING_DIRECTORY=comm/mail/branding/thunderbird"
                              base-tag: "RELEASE_{major_version}_BASE"
                              end-tag: "RELEASE_{major_version}_END"
                              from-branch: "beta"
                              to-branch: "release"
                    release-to-esr:
                        - uplift:
                              fetch-version-from: "mail/config/version.txt"
                              version-files:
                                  - filename: "mail/config/version_display.txt"
                                    new-suffix: "esr"
                              replacements: []
                              end-tag: "ESR_{major_version}_BASE"
                              to-branch: "esr153"

            # Thunderbird-specific gecko revision pinning
            gecko-rev:
                by-behavior:
                    bump-esr153:
                        source: to-branch
                        upstream: mozilla-esr153
                        tag: 'FIREFOX_{major_version}_{minor_version_plus1}(_\d+)?esr_BUILD\d'
                        base: '(FIREFOX_ESR_{major_version}_BASE|FIREFOX_{major_version}_{minor_version}(_\d+)?)esr_BUILD\d'
                    main-to-beta:
                        source: from-branch
                        upstream: mozilla-beta
                        tag: 'FIREFOX_{major_version}_0b1_BUILD\d'
                        base: 'FIREFOX_BETA_{major_version}_BASE'
                    beta-to-release:
                        source: from-branch
                        upstream: mozilla-release
                        tag: 'FIREFOX_{major_version}_0_BUILD\d'
                        base: 'FIREFOX_RELEASE_{major_version}_BASE'
                    release-to-esr:
                        source: to-branch
                        upstream: mozilla-esr153
                        tag: 'FIREFOX_{major_version}_0esr_BUILD\d'
                        base: 'FIREFOX_ESR_{major_version}_BASE'
                    default: null
        run-on-projects: []
        expiration-policy: long
        routes:
            by-level:
                '3':
                    # # Thunderbird Drivers
                    - "notify.matrix-room.!xPTYfLywxFMryjbnJl:mozilla.org.on-pending"
                    - "notify.matrix-room.!xPTYfLywxFMryjbnJl:mozilla.org.on-resolved"
                default:
                    # # Thunderbird Drivers
                    - "notify.matrix-room.!xPTYfLywxFMryjbnJl:mozilla.org.on-pending"
                    - "notify.matrix-room.!xPTYfLywxFMryjbnJl:mozilla.org.on-resolved"
        scopes:
            - "queue:route:notify.matrix-room.*"
        extra:
            notify:
                matrixBody:
                    $let:
                        dry_run:
                            $if: "'dry_run' in task.payload && task.payload.dry_run"
                            then: " (dry run)"
                            else: ""
                    in: "merge-automation task ${task.metadata.name}${dry_run} is now ${status.state}: https://firefox-ci-tc.services.mozilla.com/tasks/${taskId}"
